text:
ada: Heads-up: we had a customer hit constant 429s when the primary model saturated. They expected automatic fallback to the quantized variant but the console showed no traffic diverted.
kyle: Did they have tenant-specific routing overrides enabled? those can block automatic spillover if set to strict.
ada: Nope, default policy. The request logs show `router=primary` even after queue depth climbed.
marco: That sounds like affinity precedence. Current router prefers sticky routing to preserve KV cache locality; fallback only kicks if primary explicitly returns capacity errors.
jen: We chatted about adding a soft-evacuation probe: sample X% of requests and try a compatible variant, if latency stays OK then flip traffic. Would avoid all-or-nothing.
ada: Example probe header we discussed: `X-Rdwood-Variant-Probe: true` and `X-Rdwood-Probe-Sample: 0.02`.
ops-bot: note: new probe headers landed in staging. /deploy canary 1724506 -> staging :shipit:
kyle: UX ask: console needs a quick toggle per-tenant for "allow probe fallback" and visible time-series for probe success rate + latency delta.
console-sre: Agreed. Proposed fields: "probe_rate", "probe_timeout_ms", "preference_priority" (affinity vs freshest). We should show probe pass/fail % and avg token cost.
marco: Also need telemetry label rules: tag probe attempts with `probe=true`, `fallback_variant=redwood-quant-v2-8bit`, `origin=auto` so evals can filter.
jen: Edge case: region mismatch. If primary saturated in us-west but fallback only exists in eu-west, we should honor regional routing policy until cross-region fallback allowed by tenant.
ada: For APs we may add `prefer_local_variant=true|false` header per-tenant. Default true for enterprise accounts.
kyle: API surface question: expose `prefer_variant` hint in the request body vs header? headers are easier for gateways but body is explicit for SDKs.
marco: Keep both, SDKs can set body and gateway will map to header internally. But console controls should expose the header-level toggle.
jen: Implementation plan: 1) probe sampling middleware 2) console toggle + rollout target 3) telemetry schema + dashboard card 4) docs & migration notes.
ada: Ops note: make sure fallback doesn't count against primary token billing when probe says success on variant. We need clear billing attribution.
ops-bot: reminder: patch for billing attribution queued in billing-svc PR #482
kyle: I'll draft a small RFC and add a mock console wireframe for the toggle and probe graph. Will ping @console-sre for metrics names.
ada: Thanks — if we can get a safe default (0.5% probe, prefer_local=false for free tier) we can iterate. :thumbsup:
jen: I'll add the region-affinity exception list to the RFC too.
marco: TL;DR: add lightweight probe that can automatically enable variant spill when it proves healthy, expose a per-tenant toggle, and tag telemetry for clear ops and billing visibility."
